title: Why the tile is 32 by 33
summary: The extra column in a shared-memory transpose tile.

choices.text: To hold a halo column from the neighbouring tile, like a convolution does.
So that a column read puts the 32 lanes in 32 different banks instead of all in one.
Because a 32 × 32 tile is 4 KB, and shared memory is allocated in units larger than 4 KB.
To align each row of the tile to a 128-byte boundary for coalesced global reads.
